# Distributed Caching Proxy & Stampede Protection

High-traffic caching: probabilistic early expiration (XFetch), mutex locks on cache miss to prevent dogpiling/thundering herd, and cache tagging.

## Invariants
- PROTECT_AGAINST_CACHE_STAMPEDE_DOGPILING
- DISTRIBUTED_MUTEX_ON_CACHE_MISS
- SHORT_CIRCUIT_ON_DB_FAILURES
